calculation_handling.description: Despite 10.5.60.70(1) and 10.10.60.70(1), if a lot has a laneway-suite building, that building is not included in the overall lot coverage calculation.
calculation_handling.gaps: An exclusion rule for the lot coverage calculation; applies only when a laneway suite is present or proposed (user input). Displaces 10.5.60.70(1) and 10.10.60.70(1) for such lots. No zone is named.

units.disclosure: If you build a laneway suite, it does not count toward the lot's overall coverage limit (a separate 30% cap on all ancillary buildings applies). We apply this only when you tell us a laneway suite is planned.

calculation_handling.description: Despite 10.5.60.70(1) and 10.10.60.70(1), on a lot with a laneway suite, the area covered by all ancillary buildings combined (including the laneway suite) may not exceed 30% of the lot area.
calculation_handling.gaps: The coverage is of all ancillary buildings combined, not of the principal building; lot_coverage_pct is used with building_types limited to ancillary buildings. Applies only when a laneway suite is present or proposed (user input; no lot_condition token). Displaces 10.5.60.70(1) and 10.10.60.70(1). No zone is named.

units.disclosure: With a laneway suite, all ancillary buildings together (including the suite) may cover at most 30% of the lot. We apply this only when you tell us a laneway suite is planned.

150.8.60.70(1).explanation: If a lot has a laneway suite, the suite does not count toward the lot's overall coverage limit; instead, all ancillary buildings together, including the laneway suite, may cover at most 30% of the lot.
